tagline.en: Slice lets you choose the risk, plus 14 new profile effects.
tagline.id: Slice sekarang kamu pilih risikonya, plus 14 efek profil baru.

items.en: Slice: fruits jump up and you slice one. Each fruit has its own safe chance (watermelon 80% … grape 4%); rarer fruit pays a bigger multiplier.
items.id: Slice: buah meloncat dan kamu potong satu. Tiap buah punya peluang aman sendiri (semangka 80% … anggur 4%); buah langka bayar pengali lebih besar.

items.en: 14 profile effects in the shop: autumn leaves, sakura, snow, hearts, embers, coin rain, storm, fireflies and more.
items.id: 14 efek profil di shop: daun musim gugur, sakura, salju, hati, bara api, hujan koin, badai, kunang-kunang, dan lainnya.

items.en: Shop boosts and badges use drawn icons instead of emoji. Equip buttons in your inventory are centered.
items.id: Boost dan badge di shop pakai ikon gambar, bukan emoji. Tombol Equip di inventori sekarang di tengah.

items.en: Opening a game that is turned off or in maintenance shows a popup.
items.id: Membuka game yang dimatikan atau sedang maintenance menampilkan popup.

items.en: Layer and Moles are turned off for now.
